name: @narada-core/pc-site-runtime-observer
description: Native low-overhead PC Site MCP runtime resource observer and evidence store.

scripts.test: pnpm run build && cargo test --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml && bun test test/observer.test.ts
scripts.test:node: pnpm run build:node && cargo test --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml && node --import tsx --test test/observer.test.ts
scripts.test:live:e2e: pnpm run build && bun test test/observer.live.e2e.ts
scripts.test:live:e2e:node: pnpm run build:node && node --import tsx --test test/observer.live.e2e.ts
